FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say 'Tuesday' in French? (1 mark)
   A. mercredi
   B. samedi
   C. mardi
   D. lundi

2. How do you say 'The bed is in the bedroom.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le lit est dans la chambre.
   B. Il est sur la table.
   C. Excusez-moi, où est l'école ?
   D. Où est la clé ?

3. What does 'le ventre' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the head
   B. the eyes
   C. the knee
   D. the stomach

4. How do you say 'the window' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la maison
   B. la télé
   C. la chaise
   D. la fenêtre

5. Which month is 'juin'? (1 mark)
   A. June
   B. April
   C. January
   D. August

6. How do you say 'Tomorrow it is Thursday.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le jeudi, je chante.
   B. Le lundi, je vais à l'école.
   C. Le samedi, j'aide ma mère.
   D. Demain, c'est jeudi.

7. How do you say 'It is cloudy.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il y a des nuages.
   B. Il gèle.
   C. Il pleut.
   D. Il y a du vent.

8. What does 'Je mange une mangue.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. I eat a mango.
   B. It is a cake.
   C. It is not good for your health.
   D. They are mangoes.

9. How do you say 'Go straight ahead.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Allez tout droit.
   B. Il est sur la table.
   C. La télé est sur la table.
   D. Le chat est derrière la porte.

10. What number is 'vingt' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 8
   C. 20
   D. 3

11. Which little word goes with 'nez' (the nose)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. la
   C. le
   D. l'

12. What does 'l'enfant' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the child
   B. the baby
   C. the family
   D. the brother

13. How do you say 'How are you?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Et toi ?
   B. Ça s'écrit comment ?
   C. Comment tu t'appelles ?
   D. Ça va ?

14. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'church'? (1 mark)
   A. église
   B. églse
   C. eglise
   D. èglise

15. Fill in: vendredi, ______, dimanche. (1 mark)
   A. jeudi
   B. mardi
   C. samedi
   D. lundi

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into English: 'Elle est petite.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

17. Write the French words for: pleasant, the snow, strong (3 marks) (3 marks)

18. Write the French letter names for the name Kamau. (3 marks) (3 marks)

19. Translate into French: 'How old are you?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

20. Translate into English: 'Il fait beau.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

21. Translate into English: 'J'aime le lait.' (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #12 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — mardi
   Tuesday in French is mardi.

2. A — Le lit est dans la chambre.
   The bed is in the bedroom. in French is Le lit est dans la chambre.

3. D — the stomach
   le ventre means the stomach.

4. D — la fenêtre
   the window in French is la fenêtre.

5. A — June
   juin means June.

6. D — Demain, c'est jeudi.
   Tomorrow it is Thursday. in French is Demain, c'est jeudi.

7. A — Il y a des nuages.
   It is cloudy. in French is Il y a des nuages..

8. A — I eat a mango.
   Je mange une mangue. means I eat a mango.

9. A — Allez tout droit.
   Go straight ahead. in French is Allez tout droit.

10. C — 20
   vingt means 20.

11. C — le
   nez is masculine, so we say le nez.

12. A — the child
   l'enfant means the child.

13. D — Ça va ?
   How are you? in French is Ça va ?.

14. A — église
   The correct spelling is église, with its accents.

15. C — samedi
   Saturday comes after Friday.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: She is short.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: agréable, la neige, fort
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its accents and le or la.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: ka, ah, em, ah, ü
   Working / marking points: 3 marks for all five correct; lose 1 mark for every two mistakes.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tu as quel âge ?
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: The weather is nice.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: I like milk.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.
